comment: P4.1b help-doc-sync differential spec. The seed rows bake the pre-sync help_docs state: row 1 (getting-started) carries a STALE contentHash + an embedding, so the sync updates it and clears the embedding; row 2 (no-frontmatter) carries the MATCHING contentHash (sha256 of the trimmed fixture file bytes) plus a deliberately-different title, so the sync must leave the whole row (title, embedding, timestamps) untouched. The fixture help tree lives at fixtures/help-sync/help/ (a .gitattributes pins *.md -text so crlf.md keeps its CRLF bytes).

seed.title: Old Getting Started
seed.content: old content that has since changed on disk

seed.title: Stale Title Untouched
seed.content: stale content untouched (hash matches so nothing is rewritten)
